editions.text: Yesterday's station logged 27 species in total, against a past-week average of 23.0 species, with 154 feeder visits against an average of 200.4 and 323 detections heard against an average of 363.9. The day ran quieter than the week before it on visits and sounds while holding a slightly wider range of species. Tufted Titmouse led the visual counts with 44 visits, and Carolina Chickadee was the most heard at 60 detections, both consistent with the past week, and all of the station's regulars from the past week were recorded again. House Sparrow was seen at this station for the first time yesterday, with three visits. The audio source was switched between the pi, pi-mic, and c120 inputs many times across the past week, with the heaviest switching on October 24 and 30, so detections in that period reflect the source in use at the time rather than changes in the birds themselves.
